components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #e74c3c; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Standard data entry field on dark background.
components.css: .ds-input-field { background: #1b262c; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 12px; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 16px; border: 1px solid #37474f; border-radius: 8px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input-field:focus { border-color: #e74c3c; }

narrative.overview: The UK Expense Tracker is a focused, high-contrast, data-dense application designed for rapid scanning and operation. It eschews unnecessary ornamentation in favor of a sleek, modern, and punchy aesthetic, aggressively using color to highlight key actions and semantic meaning.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic chart colors that carry strict financial meaning.
Nocturnal, deep slate canvas to reduce eye strain during intensive data analysis.
Utilitarian component language optimized for fast, reliable data entry.

rules.name: The Strict Semantic Rule
rules.body: Financial chart colors are not decorative. Green is always income, Dark Red is always committed spend, and Orange is always variable spend.

rules.name: The Flat Structure Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows or ambient depth. Hierarchy is established purely through background contrast and spacing.

dos: Do use #e74c3c aggressively for the most important action on a screen.
Do map financial data rigidly to the established Income/Committed/Variable chart colors.
Do rely on background color contrast (#1b262c on #263238) to define sections.
donts: Don't introduce new chart colors for income or basic spend types; stick to the semantic palette.
Don't use drop shadows to separate cards or containers.
Don't sacrifice data density for whitespace; the user values seeing more rows over spacious layouts.
